title: 〜さえ〜ば
simpleExplanation: 〜さえ〜ば names one condition that is enough by itself: お金さえあれば、何でも買える = as long as you have money, you can buy anything. Nothing else matters. さえ marks the one thing; ば makes it a condition.
whenUsed: Speech and writing, wishes and reassurances. Also negative: 〜さえ〜なければ (as long as X doesn't happen). Verb forms: V-ます stem + さえすれば, V-て + さえいれば.
formation: Verb (ます stem) + さえすれば
Verb (て form) + さえいれば
な-adjective / Noun + でさえあれば

branches.label: as long as there is money
as long as you take it
as long as you keep sleeping

examples.ja: お金さえあれば、何でも買える。
examples.reading: おかねさえあれば、なんでもかえる。
examples.en: As long as you have money, you can buy anything.
examples.note: Noun + さえあれば: money is the one condition.

examples.ja: 薬を飲みさえすれば、治ります。
examples.reading: くすりをのみさえすれば、なおります。
examples.en: If you just take the medicine, you'll recover.
examples.note: V-ます stem + さえすれば: taking the medicine is enough.

examples.ja: 静かでさえあれば、どんな部屋でもいい。
examples.reading: しずかでさえあれば、どんなへやでもいい。
examples.en: As long as it's quiet, any room is fine.
examples.note: な-adjective + でさえあれば: quiet is the only requirement.

examples.ja: 君がそばにいてさえくれれば、ほかには何もいらない。
examples.reading: きみがそばにいてさえくれれば、ほかにはなにもいらない。
examples.en: As long as you're by my side, I don't need anything else.
examples.note: V-て + さえ + くれれば.

examples.ja: あの事故さえなければ、彼は今も元気に働いていただろう。
examples.reading: あのじこさえなければ、かれはいまもげんきにはたらいていただろう。
examples.en: If only that accident hadn't happened, he'd still be working happily now.
examples.note: Negative: さえなければ = if only… not.

similarGrammar.difference: Neutral condition. さえ〜ば adds "that alone is enough".
"As long as (a state continues)": 生きている限り.

commonMistakes.why: Verbs attach with the ます stem before さえすれば.
い-adjectives use the く-form before さえあれば.

commonMistakes.wrong: お金さえあったら、何でも買える。
commonMistakes.right: お金さえあれば、何でも買える。
commonMistakes.why: The pattern uses the ば-form; たら is not standard here.

usageNotes: Emphasizes that nothing else is needed. Compare 〜ば (neutral condition). Negative: 〜さえ〜なければ.
Very often paired with a positive result or a wish (〜ば〜のに).
jlptTips: さえ before the blank and a result clause after = the blank is a ば-form (あれば, すれば, いれば).
Match the verb form: ます stem + さえすれば, て-form + さえいれば. Wrong stems are the trap.
For "if only… hadn't", the pattern is さえなければ.
